turns: the dark theme flickers when the settings panel opens
The panel mounts before the theme class lands on the body, so it paints light for one frame. I moved the class onto the root element in the server render.
add a test so it stays fixed
Added a render test that opens the settings panel in dark mode and checks the first painted frame. It fails on the old code and passes now.
plan the export to CSV for the reports page
Three steps: a button on the reports toolbar, a streaming endpoint that writes rows as they are read, and a filename with the report name and date.
go with the streaming endpoint first
The endpoint streams 50 000 rows in under a second in the local run. The toolbar button is next.
why does the build take four minutes now
The image step re-encodes every icon on each build. Caching the encoded icons by content hash brings it back to 70 seconds.
rate limit the public search endpoint
Added a token bucket per API key: 20 requests a second, bursts of 40. A client over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header.
Each 429 now logs the key id and the route, sampled at one in ten so a flood does not fill the log.
migrate the orders table to the new schema
The migration copies orders in batches of 5 000 and keeps the old table until the row counts match.
sync notes between the phone and the desktop app
Notes now carry a revision number. The newer revision wins, and a conflict keeps both copies side by side.
